title: Track record (Contract C, v3)
description: Produced by component 1 alongside events. This is what draws the boxes. One object per track in tracks.jsonl.

robot_name.description: Stable job-local display name, e.g. robot1.

raw_track_ids.description: Raw tracker ids contributing to this stable identity. Full per-frame provenance remains in tracks.raw.jsonl.

merged_track_ids.description: Pre-reconciliation stable fragments merged by strong roster-constrained OCR evidence.

identity_status.description: Optional post-processing disposition; absence means the online identity was retained unchanged.

identity_issues.description: Machine-readable reasons an identity requires human review.

position_source.description: Calibration source used for optional field positions.

team_confidence.description: How sure bumper OCR is about the WHOLE track's identity. Separate from per-event confidence; this is what flags a likely misattribution.

field_x.description: Robot footprint x in field feet.

field_y.description: Robot footprint y in field feet.

velocity_x_ftps.description: Field-axis velocity in feet per second.

velocity_y_ftps.description: Field-axis velocity in feet per second.

speed_ftps.description: Ground speed in feet per second.

motion_heading_rad.description: Direction of travel in field axes; not body orientation.

gaps.description: REQUIRED, possibly empty. Intervals where the robot was not observed. Consumers must not interpolate across a listed gap -- without this a four-second hole is indistinguishable from a low sample rate, and the overlay draws a robot gliding through footage nobody analyzed. Tracks are NOT split at gaps: re-identification exists to stitch fragments into one logical track.
